title: marketplace-metadata-handoff-and-launch-ops
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a repeatable operational handoff and synchronized asset pipeline for AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplace listings so the launch window is coordinated, release notes are consistent across clouds, and last-minute metadata edits are tracked. Scope includes: canonical metadata source, templated marketplace descriptions, consolidated asset bucket (icons/screenshots), release-note canonicalization, publishing runbook, and cross-team signoffs (Legal/Security/Platform/Partner Programs). Excludes billing price lists and procurement contracts (handled by Sales/Finance).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical metadata doc exists and is the single source of truth for title, short description, long description, feature bullets, and tags
Marketplace-specific copy variants for AWS/Azure/GCP are generated from templates and stored in Drive with version history
Release notes for v2026.04 are authored, approved by Security and Legal, and formatted for three marketplace schemas
Publishing runbook with sequence (asset push -> metadata -> screenshots -> submit) has been validated in a dry run
All stakeholders have acknowledged the launch checklist in Slack and signoffs are recorded before the publish date
tasks: Inventory existing marketplace copy and assets (owner: Marco Ruiz)
Create canonical metadata spreadsheet and set editing permissions (owner: Aisha Patel)
Author templated copy snippets for cloud-specific requirements (owner: Content)
Design and export updated marketplace icons/screenshots at required sizes (owner: Evan Brooks)
Implement automated asset sync to the publish bucket and verify checksums (owner: ENG-Infra)
Draft release notes and map to marketplace fields; include rollback messaging (owner: Marco Ruiz)
Security & Legal review of all public-facing statements (owner: Priya Nair)
Schedule publishing runbook dry-run and capture timing metrics (owner: Aisha Patel)
Coordinate with partner programs for marketplace-specific partner badges (owner: Partnerships)
Final publish and post-publish verification (owner: Marco Ruiz)
Post-launch monitoring and user-reported issue triage for 72 hours (owner: ENG-SRE)
rollout_plan: T-14 days: Complete canonical metadata and asset inventory
T-10 days: Security & Legal review; fix any compliance blockers
T-7 days: Dry-run publish to sandbox listing in at least one cloud and validate schema
T-3 days: Freeze copy and assets; convene final signoff meeting
Launch day: Execute publishing runbook sequentially across regions; monitor errors
T+1 to T+3 days: Verify metrics (impressions, installs, errors) and address regressions
T+7 days: Retro and update runbook with observed timing and failure modes
go_to_market_tasks: Add marketplace links to product website and docs
Update Quickstart templates to reference marketplace installs where applicable
Notify key pilot customers and enable Partner badge placements
Prepare a short blog post and social copy aligned to publish window
release_notes_summary: Release marketplace-ready listing artifacts for v2026.04: improved latency/throughput, Dedicated capacity billing clarity, Private deployment RBAC enhancements. Release notes include migration notes for Dedicated customers and an opt-in path for early access to Private deployer features.
risk_mitigation: If marketplace submission is rejected, fall back to hosted API announcement and delay marketplace publish by rolling back to previous metadata
Maintain a rolling 24-hour rollback window for any listing changes that introduce legal/security concerns
Keep a read-only snapshot of pre-publish assets to allow re-submission without data-loss
Design team to produce micro-variants of images to address marketplace rejected image constraints
